images.description: AI-generated conceptual editorial illustration of community contribution. Not a historical photograph.
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide editorial hero illustration for a thoughtful essay titled Social Coin: A Contribution Economy Beyond UBI. Create a new artwork using the supplied image ONLY as a style reference, not as an edit target.
Primary request: an allegorical collage of the invisible economy of care, teaching, creativity and community, made visible through shared value.
Style: closely match the reference's antique black ink copperplate engravings, delicate stippling, cut-paper collage edges, subtly aged warm ivory paper, tactile print grain, and one oversized flat burnt-orange circular disc. Surreal scale relationships, sophisticated literary magazine illustration, rich detail but uncluttered. Grayscale ink with orange as the only saturated color.
Composition: landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels, 3:2. A pair of large carefully engraved human hands in a supportive gesture occupy the middle foreground, one gently holding another's hand, not a business handshake. Behind them an oversized coin-like circular disc in burnt orange, with thin concentric engraved rims but NO monetary symbol, numbers or writing. Below, a modest community garden and a small open-air teaching scene at a table connect through winding paths, with a few small human figures. A botanical branch and a small open book become collage elements at the edges. Subtle dotted orbital lines connect the small scenes around the central disc, as in the reference. Generous warm paper breathing room near top and edges. The composition should suggest human reciprocity and value moving through a community, with accurate natural hands and grounded details.
Constraints: no text, letters, slogans, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, cryptocurrency branding, giant currency symbols, robot hands, steam engine or factory. This is symbolic editorial art, not a factual chart or historical photograph. Keep the same warm paper/charcoal/orange visual family as the reference.

images.description: AI-generated conceptual editorial illustration of agricultural measurement and living soil. Not a scientific diagram or historical photograph.
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide editorial hero illustration for the essay The Pathology of More, a critique of single-metric maximization in agriculture. Create a new artwork using the supplied image ONLY as a style reference, not an edit target.
Primary request: a visual metaphor for the tension between maximizing agricultural output and caring for the living system that makes food possible.
Style: match the reference's nineteenth-century black ink engravings, etched and stippled fine detail, vintage scientific plates, torn paper collage, warm ivory grainy paper and a large burnt-orange circular disc. High quality literary magazine art, surreal editorial collage rather than photorealism. Orange is the only saturated color.
Composition: landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels, 3:2. A monumental engraved wheat stalk rises at left-center, oversized relative to tiny orderly field rows and a small tractor below. At center-right an antique mechanical weighing scale or measurement dial without any readable numerals looms over the crop; the visual suggests agriculture being reduced to measurement. A large matte burnt-orange sun/disc sits behind the upper stalk and instrument. The lower third is a beautifully detailed cutaway of earth with interwoven roots, an earthworm and subtle soil pores, continuous beneath both the field and a small diverse patch of plants. At the far right, a small human figure looks down into the exposed soil rather than up toward the apparatus. A restrained dotted orbital arc links grain, instrument and roots. Balance visually dense engraved elements against open paper and the orange disc. Let roots quietly carry as much visual importance as the crop aboveground.
Constraints: no text, letters, words, arrows, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, skulls, sensational catastrophe, glowing cyberpunk visuals or fabricated data plots. Do not reproduce the reference's robot hand or steam engine. This is conceptual editorial art, not scientific evidence or a literal historical scene.
